name: Otukpo

routes.httpStatus: Discovery result available; direct curl timed out/failed to connect after 30 seconds
routes.outcome: Official BENGIS site identifies itself as Benue State Government's geospatial-data custodian and a one-stop shop for digital mapping and land services. It advertises an Explore Map route and land-document services. No parcel response was obtained.

Public portal resolves to a sign-in page requiring email/phone, password and verification image. No login, CAPTCHA interaction or private-token use was attempted; no anonymous parcel service response was exposed.

Official application guidance says survey reports are vetted by the Cadastral Unit and plotted/saved into the system, and accepts survey maps, TDPs, coordinates or site plans. This establishes a custodial workflow, not a public parcel API.

Official Benue Ministry Survey Department describes plot demarcation, survey-coordinate storage, photogrammetric town maps, cartographic title-deed traces and public map-sheet sales/inspection. No parcel feature endpoint or downloadable safe parcel geometry was exposed.
Official Nigeria Geological Survey Agency lists Otukpo topographic sheets 270 and 289. These are general topographic products, not cadastral parcels, and were not retained as parcel evidence.
Official Benue State Government site identifies the Ministry of Lands, Survey & Solid Minerals and links to the BENGIS service centre. No separate public parcel API was found.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: No current public JavaScript/configuration or service endpoint yielding an anonymous Otukpo parcel response was recovered. The public portal is login-gated; direct BENGIS fetch timed out.

The BENGIS timeout, login wall and absent public schema are route limitations, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

BENGIS is the relevant state/local land-information custodian; the Ministry of Lands and Survey is the responsible survey authority. NGSA was recorded only as a general topographic source, not a parcel registry.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel identity and unchanged parcel geometry were obtained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title or personal fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: BENGIS's existence, Benue custodial role and cadastral workflow are well evidenced, but anonymous endpoint reachability, parcel coverage in Otukpo, schema, CRS, stable parcel identity and update cadence remain unverified. Runtime/admission remains held.
